create_OvisProcessor: create an OvisProcessor instance wrapping an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal text-image inputs
process_image_text_inputs: process images and text with <image> placeholders into tokenized input_ids, pixel_values, and grids
preprocess_image: preprocess a single PIL image by resizing, padding to square, and partitioning into a grid of crops
construct_image_placeholders: construct padded token placeholders for an image grid with start, atom, separator, and end markers
decode_generated_outputs: decode model generated token outputs into human-readable text strings
